meta.name: vmcp-review
meta.description: Reviews vMCP code changes for known anti-patterns that make the codebase harder to understand or more brittle. Use when reviewing PRs, planning features, or refactoring vMCP code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查 vMCP 代码变更中的反模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在开发或维护 vMCP server 代码，需要避免常见陷阱。
copy.tagline_en: Review vMCP code changes for anti-patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop or maintain vMCP server code and want to avoid common pitfalls.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查 vMCP 代码中的反模式，指出哪些地方让代码更难懂、更脆弱，并给出修复建议。
howto.when: 当你提交 PR、规划新功能或重构 vMCP 代码时，Claude 会自动审查相关文件。

say.text: 帮我审查这个 PR 中的 vMCP 代码改动。
say.note: Claude 会分析变更文件并报告反模式。

say.text: 检查 pkg/vmcp/ 目录下所有 Go 文件的反模式。
say.note: Claude 会审计整个包并列出问题。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude reviews vMCP code for known anti-patterns that make the codebase harder to understand or more brittle, and suggests fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when reviewing PRs, planning features, or refactoring vMCP code. Claude examines changed files under pkg/vmcp/ and cmd/vmcp/.

say_en.text: Review the vMCP code changes in this PR for anti-patterns.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the diff and report issues.

say_en.text: Audit all Go files in pkg/vmcp/ for anti-patterns.
say_en.note: Claude will scan the entire package and list findings.
